metaDescription: Get random writing prompts for horror, romance, science fiction, fantasy, mystery, drama, humour and historical fiction. Free and private.
intro: Get random creative writing prompts by genre: horror, romance, science fiction, fantasy, mystery, drama, humour or historical.
why:
A blank page is easier to start when a prompt gives you a person, a place and a problem.

Pick a genre or let the tool choose. Each prompt joins one of eight characters, eight settings and eight complications, so each genre offers 512 combinations. Add a seed text to get the same list again. Everything is generated in your browser.
howTo: Set how many prompts you want.
Optionally enter a seed to repeat the list.
Pick one and write for ten minutes.

faq.a: They are combinations of short original elements written for this tool.

faq.q: Can I get the same prompts again?
faq.a: Yes, enter the same seed text.

faq.q: May I use them in published work?
faq.a: Yes. They are ideas, not text to copy.
